items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Now this fellow Madelea, he asked me Sunday about the... It's his boy. I think his boy was out with us Sunday, he was.

ctx.x: How old does a man have to be to join the Jolly Boy? 18 to 65. 18 to 65. Once you hit 65 you can't join? No, after you get over that. Well we got some of them in there over that.

But that's the rule. We have a lot of youngsters. Around 8, 7, 15, 16 years old, 13 years old, they parade with us. We don't charge them nothing to parade. All they do is just buy their parents, buy their clothes and they... We'll have maybe eight to ten youngsters, brothers like that. All up. They don't charge them nothing to parade. Because you can't join the club, they do young, but we just let them come out. Now this fellow Madelea, he asked me Sunday about the... It's his boy. I think his boy was out with us…
Your tax a club when a member dies, in other words?
